title: Degree of a Boolean monomial
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a subset $S$ of the coordinate set $	ext{Fin}(n)$, the function on the Boolean cube over $ br/	ext{?}$ given by the product of the coordinates indexed by $S$ has algebraic degree at most $|S|$.
caveat: The cube is over the two-element field, not the reals; the displayed field notation should be read as the field with two elements.
